The '''Knell of Muspilli''' was a [[Death/Legends|death]] cult that dwelt among the [[Moon tree|moon-trees]] of the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]] within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The Knell claimed to possess the ability to summon apocalyptic [[Deity/Legends|deities]] from the realm [[beyond shadows]]. In time, the philosophy of the Knell of Muspilli and [[Kanzer Exiles|other]] [[Warriors of Shadow|groups]] from the Unknown Regions became part of the ideological foundation of the later organization known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]].

==History==
At the dawn of history, a [[Death/Legends|death]] cult known as the Knell of Muspilli dwelt amid the drifting [[Moon tree|moon-trees]],<ref name="BS" /> which blossomed in the interstellar space of the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]] deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="SM" /> The cult’s followers claimed to have possessed the power to summon apocalyptic [[Deity/Legends|deities]] from the realm [[beyond shadows]]. To perform such a ritual, they transcribed the [[Taurannik Codex]] in the hope of opening the Gap’s spatial fissure.<ref name="UR" />

[[File:Talzinbos.jpg|left|thumb|240px|Mother Talzin doubted the true capabilities of the cult, as she had found no evidence to support their claims]]
At some point after [[200,000 BBY]], the Knell of Muspilli engaged in a terrible [[Battle above a nameless moon|naval battle]] against a [[Warriors of Shadow|sisterhood offshoot]] of the [[Taung/Legends|Warriors of the Shadow]] above an [[Unidentified moon (Unknown Regions)|unnamed]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the Unknown Regions. [[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later, during the tense period of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the ancient battlefield was discovered, where derelict [[Starship/Legends|starships]] still remained.<ref name="Battle of Terror">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Battle of Terror}}</ref>

Many [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, mention of the Knell of Muspilli appeared in the ''[[Book of Sith]]'', within the section «[[Wild Power]]», authored by the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witch]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], who regarded the true capabilities of the organization with skepticism.<ref name="BS" />

During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] adept [[Cronal]] visited the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]] and searched among the drifting moon-trees, where he found scraps of the [[Taurannik Codex]], which had been destroyed in the ancient [[Muurshantre Extinction|cataclysm]]. The cultists who had once inhabited the site did not oppose Cronal, although it was likely that, by that time, their society had already vanished.<ref name="SM" /> However, the sect’s existence had not passed without trace, for over many generations their philosophical schools – together with the fanatical flock of the [[Kanzer Exiles]] and the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] [[Warriors of Shadow|priestly]] community – gave rise to the religious movement known as the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]] beneath the shroud of the [[Perann Nebula/Legends|Perann Nebula]] within the same [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="UR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Knell of Muspilli was first mentioned in the [[2010]] reference guide ''[[The Unknown Regions]]''. It seemed that the name of the sect had originated from [[wikipedia:de:Muspell|Muspell]], the name of a mythological being from [[wikipedia:en:Norse mythology|Norse mythology]].
